subject.title: fix(feishu): retry transient message send failures

question: Should Feishu create/reply sends adopt this two-retry transient classifier and stable-UUID idempotency boundary after the branch is refreshed onto current main?
rationale: The implementation is technically supported and well-proven, but it intentionally changes message-delivery semantics across text, cards, media messages, and streaming starts; repository policy routes that delivery-risk choice to a Feishu-area human.

options.title: Approve after exact-head refresh
options.body: Refresh onto current main, confirm the focused Feishu suites and live stable-UUID proof still pass, then approve the bounded retry policy.

options.title: Narrow the classifier
options.body: Limit retries to the field-observed errors or a smaller status and code set if owners want a more conservative first release.

options.title: Keep single-attempt delivery
options.body: Decline the retry policy and leave transient send recovery for a broader durable-delivery design.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head refresh
recommendation.body: Refresh onto current main, confirm the focused Feishu suites and live stable-UUID proof still pass, then approve the bounded retry policy.
